caption:
Thai chicken Meatballs with Red Curry Coconut Sauce
high protein | meal prep friendly

Nutrition: 
C: 23 | F: 28 | P: 38
Calories: 544 per serve 
Serves 3 large portions

Ingredients
For the Thai Meatballs
450 grams chicken mince
1 egg
3 spring onion greens, chopped 
5 garlic cloves, finely chopped
1 1/2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tbsp red curry paste
1/2 tbsp soy
1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs for binding, can be omitted to reduce carbs but you wont get the meatball shape properly 
salt + pepper, to taste
1 tsp oil, to cook meatballs, dont want to use oil? use an airfryer

Coconut curry sauce 
1/2 tbsp oil
1 green / red capsicum, sliced
1 onion, sliced
200 grams button mushroom, thinly sliced
1 - 1.5 tbsp curry paste, depends on how strong your paste is in flavour
1 can coconut milk ( 400 ml ) 
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar / jaggery powder 

To garnish, chopped cilantro / peanuts 

Method
add all the ingredients except the oil to a bowl and mix together
set aside to marinate then when ready to cook, form into meatballs, you get around 12 
add oil to the pan and cook the meatballs through and set aside

to make the curry, add oil to the kadhai, add in ggp + onions and stir then all the other vegetables you want to use 
once cooked, add in curry paste, combine and stir in the coconut milk and soy, if you want more gravy like me and not to be too thick, add 1 cup light vegetable stock too
let it come to a boil, add in the jaggery powder combine combine, add in meatballs, simmer for 1-2 minutes 
top with coriander
